title: This was a great tour, and well worth the price.
text: If you choose to go up a tower, make sure you're OK with walking down 440 steps (elevator up). There are places you can look down the stairs with a hand rail only on the wall side, so it can be scary if looking down hundreds of feet gives you anxiety. The best time to go is on a sunny day in the a.m. or early p.m. so you get the real impact of the light coming in the windows either in the morning on one side or the afternoon before the sun sets on the other.
